options.error:
Commit message does not follow the house format.
Required: [optional-issue] Keyword Description
Keyword must be one of: Add, Implement, Introduce, Update, Refactor, Improve, Change, Bump, Deprecate, Remove, Delete, Drop, Fix, Correct, Resolve, Security

actions.action: bash -c 'grep -qEi "(Co-Authored-By|Generated with).*(Claude|Gemini|Copilot|ChatGPT)" "$1" && echo "ERROR: AI attribution is not allowed in commit messages" && exit 1 || exit 0' -- {$MESSAGE_PATH}
